blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The municipal government of Magsingal has imposed a two-day liquor ban in all public cemeteries and within a 300-meter radius of their boundaries on Nov. 1 and 2 to maintain peace and order during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. Under Executive Order No. 69, Series of 2026, signed by Mayor Victoria Ina Favis on Wednesday, Oct. 28, the ban will take effect at 12:01 a.m. on Nov. 1 and remain in force until 11:59 p.m. on Nov. 2.
